tagline: The world's iconic backwaters, now electric and fast.
summary: Kerala's backwaters are a famous inland-water tourism landscape centred on Kochi, Alleppey and Vembanad Lake. Kochi already runs India's first integrated electric ferry — the Water Metro — proving demand and a clean-mobility mandate on protected, ideal-for-foiling waters.

demand_signals.note: Operating proof of demand + clean-mobility commitment

demand_signals.note: Houseboat + resort tourism on Vembanad & Alleppey — largely diesel

use_cases.title: Water-metro integration
use_cases.body: Fast silent Kochi harbour hops (Fort Kochi ~3 nm) integrating with the existing electric Water Metro.

use_cases.title: Backwater premium links
use_cases.body: Kochi↔Alleppey (~30 nm) and the Vembanad lake resorts (~10 nm) — far faster than road.

use_cases.title: Backwater line-haul
use_cases.body: The classic Kochi↔Kollam (~45 nm) backwater corridor.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Every Kerala corridor (Fort Kochi ~3 nm, Kochi↔Alleppey ~30 nm, lake hops ~10 nm, Kochi↔Kollam ~45 nm) sits inside the all-electric envelope over flat protected backwater — perfect foiling conditions complementing the electric Water Metro.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Held in reserve for longer coastal chaining; the backwater network itself is fully all-electric.

competitive_landscape: Today: the electric Kochi Water Metro plus diesel houseboats and local ferries. The pain is slow diesel tourism craft on an ecologically sensitive Ramsar wetland — the status quo a clean, low-wake tier improves on.
seasonality: Backwaters run year-round; SW monsoon affects open-coast legs only. Flat sheltered water suits foiling in all seasons.
regulatory_note: Kerala operates the electric Kochi Water Metro under public mandate and has strong environmental governance over the Vembanad Ramsar wetland — zero-emission, low-wake foiling serves both the regulatory and conservation agenda.

precedents.what: A foiling-electric vessel network at national scale (~100 vessels / $100M, 3-year phasing)
precedents.why_it_matters: Proves foiling-electric works as an at-scale transfer-and-island-hopping network, not just a pilot.
